question: The first oil-field in Independent India was discovered in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first oil field in independent India** was discovered in **Assam**.
 
• While oil extraction had already begun in Assam during British rule, the **first discovery** made after India's independence in 1947 occurred in **Nahorkatia**, **Assam**, in **1953**.
 
• This discovery was followed by another in **Moran**, **Assam**, in **1956**.
 
• Both were made by the **Assam Oil Company (AOC)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Oil and gas were indeed discovered in Mumbai High, Maharashtra, in 1970s.
 
• Gujarat has become a major oil and gas producer for India, but significant discoveries began in the 1960s.
 
• **Petroleum **is present on Earth as a naturally occurring dark oil liquid beneath the surface.
 
 
• Petroleum is the source of both **diesel **and **petrol**.
